coverage.selection: Exactly the indexed jobs whose template equals goal; both detail and children endpoints read.
coverage.stateSemantics: States and mutable fields are observed at read time, not reconstructed at T.

nullPolicy.apiNull: The API explicitly returned null; it supplied no further value or cause.
nullPolicy.omitted: The API did not supply this field; no value is inferred.
nullPolicy.unavailable: The endpoint or parent object was unavailable; see errors.

coverage.childJobIdMapping: child.jobId when non-null, otherwise child.job.id when supplied; no inferred link. State is child.state, not child.job.state.

fields.why: launch.open opens a job that ends in a launch; set onchain to true or to a launch kind
